_comment: Baseline of accepted LaunchOps drift_flags fingerprints (from .launchops/drift_report.json -> drift_flags). CI gate (scripts/ci/verify_launchops_drift_flags_baseline.sh) compares against this file and fails on any fingerprint not listed here. To accept a new flag, run the gate with UPDATE_BASELINE=1 and commit this file alongside the human review evidence it represents. Fingerprint = sha256(json.dumps({severity, flag_type, sorted(files)}, sort_keys=True))[:16]. Overlaps with deep_red_flags.baseline.json are intentional: deep_red_flags is a post-scan aggregation, drift_report is the pre-aggregation per-commit signal; both must stay in sync or one is stale.
